app.name: Scholia
conversation.moveHint: A conversation moves only to a project protected at the same level or more. Its history moves with it; what it spent stays where it was spent.
conversation.noTargets: There is no other project to move it to.
conversation.deleteBody: Its messages are deleted. What it spent stays in its project's spending.
conversation.emptyTitle: What would you like to work on?
conversation.emptyBody: Ask a question, or describe what you need. Scholia answers in this conversation and remembers where you left off.
conversation.loadFailed: This conversation could not be loaded.
composer.label: Message
composer.hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
turn.revoked: The project changed during this run.
turn.limit: This conversation reached its budget. Raise it in Settings, then continue.
turn.unsaved: This answer was shown but could not be saved.
panel.libraryEmpty: Your papers and files will appear here.
setup.intro: A research assistant for reading, thinking and writing. It uses AI models through OpenRouter, with your own key.
setup.keyHelp: How do I get a key?
setup.otherProviders: Other providers can be added later in Settings.
setup.storeWarning: Your system's key store was unavailable, so the key is kept in a private file in Scholia's data folder.
settings.title: Settings
settings.backgroundRunsHint: Work Scholia does after an answer, such as titling a conversation.
settings.noRuns: Nothing has run in the background yet.
settings.dataFolderHint: Scholia keeps its database, files and settings here, readable only by your account.
dataFolder.title: Scholia cannot use its data folder
dataFolder.synced: The data folder is inside a folder that syncs to the cloud or sits on a network drive, where its database could be damaged.
dataFolder.unsafe: Another account on this Mac could change what the data folder holds, so Scholia will not open it.
errors.unreachable: Scholia's engine is not responding. Close Scholia and open it again.
errors.active_run: This conversation is still working. Wait for it, or stop it.
errors.model_needed: Choose a model for this provider in Settings.
errors.no_provider: No model provider is set up yet.
errors.provider_key_missing: The provider has no key. Add it in Settings.
errors.unknown_provider: That provider is not set up.
errors.invalid_request: Something in the form is not valid.
errors.settings_changed: The settings changed meanwhile. Try again.
errors.conversation_moved: The conversation moved to another project. Send again.
errors.less_strict_project: A conversation can move only to a project protected at the same level or more.
errors.key_not_saved: The key could not be saved.
errors.general_project: The General project cannot be deleted, and stays Normal.
errors.session_required: This page is not Scholia's own window.
errors.network: The provider could not be reached.
errors.timeout: The provider took too long to answer.
errors.quota: The provider's account has run out of credit.
errors.rate_limit: The provider is limiting requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.malformed: The provider's answer could not be read.
errors.refused: This request is not allowed for this project.
errors.save_failed: The answer could not be saved.
errors.cancelled: The message was stopped before it was sent.
errors.invalid_effort: That effort level is not available.
errors.not_continuable: Only the latest stopped or interrupted answer can be continued.
settings.changedOnDisk: The settings file changed outside Scholia, so this change was not saved. It has been read again; make the change again if you still want it.
settings.followUp: While Scholia is working, a new message
settings.followUpHint: Steering reaches the agent at its next step. Waiting sends it as the next turn.
settings.conversationBudgetHint: Costs are estimates. At the budget, the step already running finishes and nothing new starts.
settings.personalInstructionsHint: Your AGENTS.md: read at the start of every conversation, in every project.
settings.projectInstructionsHint: This project's AGENTS.md, read after your own instructions.
settings.instructionsSize: {used} of {cap} KiB, with the other instructions
settings.instructionsOverCap: Together the instructions are over 32 KiB; only the first 32 KiB is used.
settings.projectLimitsHint: Leave a field empty to use your own setting.
settings.limitsHint: Within the budgets. A project can set its own.
settings.rolesHint: Leave a role empty to let Scholia choose.
roles.councilHint: One model, or several separated by commas.
roles.routerHint: Picks the model and effort when Auto is chosen.
roles.judgeHint: Checks that each cited passage supports its claim.
roles.extractorHint: Finds what to remember from your messages.
settings.localServersHint: A server such as Ollama or LM Studio is added as an endpoint under Providers and models, and declared there for use in Private and Local only projects.
providers.intro: Connect a provider first, then choose its models. Keys are kept in your system's key store, never in a settings file.
providers.addHint: For another provider, or a model server on this Mac. Scholia sends requests only to this address.
providers.name: Name
providers.addressHint: https, or http on this Mac only.
providers.keyHint: A local server that asks for no key accepts any text, such as local.
providers.replaceKey: Paste a new key to replace it
providers.defaultWindowHint: Used for models that report none, and as a cap. At least 4,096.
providers.perModel: Each model's window, effort and price
providers.windowTrust: Scholia relies on a window you set and cannot verify it. A setting can lower a reported window, never raise it.
subagents.modelsHint: Up to five, in order of preference. The agent picks from this list for each task, then falls back to the first, then to the conversation's model. Models this project's level does not allow are skipped.
subagents.empty: Empty: subagents use the conversation's model.
subagents.effortCapHint: minimal, low, medium, high or xhigh.
project.venueHint: Where the work is headed, such as a journal.
project.citationStyleHint: Empty: chosen from the manuscript's language.
project.budgetHint: Everything in the project counts toward it.
picker.label: Model: {model}
picker.autoHint: Scholia picks the model and effort for each request
picker.none: No models match. Providers and models are set in Settings.
effort.label: Effort
effort.unknownHint: This model's effort steps are not checked yet, so it runs at its own default.
errors.window_too_small: A window is at least 4,096 tokens.
settings.problemValue: Line {line}: {key} is not valid, so its default is used.
settings.problemFile: The settings file is not valid at line {line}, so the defaults are used.
settings.problemFileUnread: The settings file could not be read, so the defaults are used.
picker.setWindow: Set the window of {model} to use it
settings.instructionsReplaced: This file is not UTF-8 text. Some characters could not be read and are shown as �; saving it replaces them for good.
errors.model_not_offered: That model is not offered for this provider. Choose it under Providers and models, or pick another.
errors.model_window: That model has no usable context window. Set one under Providers and models, or pick another model.
errors.refresh_failed: The provider's model list could not be read. Check its connection, then try again.
settings.instructionsUnreadable: This file could not be read, so it cannot be edited here. Check its permissions in the data folder.
protection.question: What will this project hold?
protection.ownHint: Any model you set up may be used.
protection.private: Unpublished work or personal data, such as interview transcripts
protection.privateHint: Private: only OpenRouter's zero-retention models, and model servers on this Mac that you declared.
protection.review: Someone else's submission, for peer review
protection.reviewHint: Review lock: kept on this Mac, and Scholia's AI help is off in this project.
protection.venue: Journal or funder of the submission
protection.venuePlaceholder: Optional; an unknown venue is treated as the strictest
protection.title: What this project holds
protection.hint: A stricter answer applies at once and stops work running in this project. A less strict one asks first. Every change is recorded in the audit log.
protection.localOnlyNow: Only models on this Mac are used. Choose an answer above to change that.
protection.lockFirst: Lift the review lock before choosing a less strict answer.
protection.loosen.normal: From now on, this project's text may go to any model you set up, including providers that keep data.
protection.loosen.private: From now on, this project's text may go to OpenRouter's zero-retention models, as well as to declared servers on this Mac.
protection.unlockBody: Scholia's AI help comes back in this project. It stays Local only until you change that too.
protection.generalNote: The General project is for anything outside a project, and stays Normal. Create a project for private work.
privacy.key.intro: For a Private project, OpenRouter's settings for this key, in your account or organization and in its workspace, must keep this key's prompts and responses out of OpenRouter's three opt-in data features:
privacy.key.logging: Input & Output Logging is off, or excludes this key.
privacy.key.improvement: The setting that lets OpenRouter use inputs and outputs to improve its product is off.
privacy.key.broadcast: Broadcast sends no content from this key: it is off, it excludes this key, or every destination that receives this key's traces uses Privacy Mode.
privacy.key.unverifiable: Scholia cannot check these settings: an ordinary key cannot read them. It records your confirmation in the audit log, and asks again in six months, when the key changes, or when this statement changes.
privacy.local.statement: This server runs its models on this Mac, and passes no request on to another service.
privacy.local.unverifiable: Scholia cannot verify this, and a relay to a cloud model would break it. Your declaration is recorded in the audit log.
privacy.local.private: For a Private project, this is your own assurance, not a retention guarantee like OpenRouter's zero retention.
keyConfirm.title: Use in Private projects
keyConfirm.status.missing: Not confirmed: Private projects refuse this key.
keyConfirm.status.other_key: Not confirmed for this key: Private projects refuse it.
keyConfirm.status.expired: The confirmation has expired: Private projects refuse this key.
keyConfirm.status.outdated: This statement changed since you confirmed it: Private projects refuse this key.
keyConfirm.observabilityLink: Logging and Broadcast settings on OpenRouter
localDeclare.title: A model server on this Mac
localDeclare.declared: Declared {date}: Private and Local only projects may use it.
localDeclare.undeclared: Not declared: Private and Local only projects do not use it.
allowlist.title: Private allowlist
allowlist.hint: The OpenRouter routes Private projects may use. Every request also carries OpenRouter's zero-retention flag. Shipped entries were checked against OpenRouter's terms on {date}.
allowlist.every: Every OpenRouter model with a zero-retention endpoint
allowlist.stale: Checked over six months ago, so it may be out of date.
allowlist.exception.plugins_and_tools: Zero retention covers model requests only, not plugins or server tools; Scholia sends none.
allowlist.exception.in_memory_caching: OpenRouter does not count in-memory prompt caching as retention.
allowlist.exception.key_data_settings: Your key's data settings must also be confirmed, under Providers and models.
allowlist.addPlaceholder: A model id, such as vendor/model
allowlist.addHint: An entry for one model comes before the entry for every model: turn it off to keep that model out.
audit.title: Audit log
audit.hint: What Scholia decided and changed: requests sent or refused, changes to protection and keys, deletions and exports. It never holds your content.

audit.sent.one: {count} request from this project left this Mac, as far as this log goes.
audit.sent.other: {count} requests from this project left this Mac, as far as this log goes.

audit.clearBody: Every entry is deleted. A record that the log was cleared stays.

picker.protected.local_only: Local only project: only declared servers on this Mac are shown.
picker.protected.locked: Review-locked project: Scholia's AI help is off.

errors.private_route_not_allowed: Private projects use only OpenRouter models with a zero-retention endpoint on the Private allowlist. Pick another.
errors.not_declared: That server on this Mac is not declared yet. Declare it under Providers and models.
errors.key_not_confirmed: Confirm your OpenRouter key's data settings under Providers and models before using it in a Private project.
errors.project_changed: The project's protection changed meanwhile. Try again.
errors.statement_changed: The statement changed. Read it again, then confirm.
errors.not_openrouter: Only an OpenRouter key is confirmed here.
errors.not_local: Only a server on this Mac can be declared.
